items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Ben Paul told me that you were the best fiddle player he ever had in his life.

ctx.x: That's all I was playing. No, no. Southside? Yeah. Oh, sure.
Well, Ben Paul told me that you were the best fiddle player he ever had in his life.
Oh, goodness. Well, no, seriously, I was playing on a job at Dublin in a four-piece combination before I come out here, clarinet and fiddle. And just recently? Just before I come out here.
